verbatimReport:
Repo is green (86/86 existing source-coverage tests pass), so everything below is a gap in the design, not a broken checkout. All results are from driving the real functions via scripted `StageCaller`s (`/tmp/rt/e2e.ts`, `e2e2.ts`, `e2e3.ts`, `e2e4.ts`, `p1.ts`-`p4.ts`).

# VERDICT: BLOCKER

16 of 16 constructed silent-omission scenarios ran end-to-end through `runSemanticInventory` -> `reconcileInventoryWithComposition` -> `rollupAgreementSemanticStatus`; 14 produced `unaccountedSource=[]`, `uninventoriedValues=[]`, `inventoryStatus=INVENTORY_OK`, `semanticallyComplete=true`, rollup `SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE` - with material operative text dropped.

---

## 1. BLOCKER - ALL-CAPS operative text is dismissed as a heading
`lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic-accountability/source-coverage.ts:210` (`ALLCAPS_CAPTION_RE`), applied at `:238`.

`^\s*[A-Z][A-Z0-9\s,'&/.-]{2,80}\s*$` matches *any* all-caps line up to 82 chars. All-caps is the standard drafting register for jury-trial waivers, warranty disclaimers and liability caps.

Input (region `operative`, model inventories the first and third lines only):
```
The Borrower shall repay the Loans in accordance with Section 2.05.
EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY
The Administrative Agent shall give notice of any prepayment.
```
Observed: waiver line -> `HEADING_OR_LABEL`; `INVENTORY_OK`, `unaccountedSource=0`, `uninventoriedValues=0`, `semanticallyComplete=true`, rollup `SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE`, gap call not even attempted. A jury-trial waiver vanished with zero signal.

Boundary measured: all-caps <=82 chars -> `HEADING_OR_LABEL`; 84 chars -> `UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE`. This is a **length ceiling deciding eligibility for scrutiny**, which claim (1) explicitly denies.

Also silent under the same rule (S10): `IN NO EVENT SHALL THE AGGREGATE LIABILITY EXCEED FIVE MILLION DOLLARS` - the spelled-out amount is invisible to the scanner (finding 7), so the value guard at `:228` never fires.

## 2. BLOCKER - a whole short numbered clause is dismissed as a caption
`source-coverage.ts:209` (`NUMBERED_CAPTION_RE`), applied at `:238`.

Body allowance is `[A-Za-z][\w\s,'&/-]{0,80}` - i.e. an entire numbered obligation up to ~86 chars reads as a caption.

Input (model inventories 6.01 and 6.03 only):
```
6.01 The Borrower shall deliver annual financial statements to the Agent.
6.02 The Borrower shall not create any Lien on the Collateral
6.03 The Borrower shall maintain insurance with reputable insurers at all times.
```
Observed: `6.02 ...` -> `HEADING_OR_LABEL`; `INVENTORY_OK`, `unaccounted=0`, `semanticallyComplete=true`, rollup `SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE`. An entire negative covenant dropped.

Boundary: body <=80 chars -> heading; 82 chars -> unaccounted. Same length-ceiling defect. Scenario V4 shows the variant carrying a cap: `5.02 The maximum aggregate basket amount is 2,500,000` -> `HEADING_OR_LABEL`, silent (commas are inside the permitted body class and a bare `2,500,000` is not a scanned value).

## 3. BLOCKER - `FUNCTION_WORDS` swallows material clauses (the predicted hole is real)
`source-coverage.ts:180-196` (list), `:201-204` (`contentWords`), `:233` (`STRUCTURAL_NOISE`).

The comment at `:176-179` claims "every content word in the language is outside it by construction". False: the list contains liability-allocation adverbs, anti-evasion adverbs, arithmetic operators and reference nouns. `contentWords` also strips enumerators and never sees digits (`WORD_RE = /[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'-]*/`), so section numbers are invisible too.

Classifier probes (`/tmp/rt/p1.ts`), all -> `STRUCTURAL_NOISE`:
- `"jointly and severally,"`
- `"directly or indirectly,"`
- `"except as provided in Section 6.02,"`
- `"minus the sum of the foregoing,"` / `"less the sum of clauses (a) and (b),"` / `"plus the product of the foregoing,"`
- `"solely,"`, `"only,"`, `"unless otherwise provided,"`, `"subject to the following,"`, `"notwithstanding the foregoing,"`

Because `segmentSourceUnits` splits after every comma (`:155`), these are exactly the fragments left between two anchored clauses. End-to-end:

- S3: `The Borrowers shall repay the Obligations, jointly and severally, on the Maturity Date.` with items on the two outer clauses -> `jointly and severally,` = `STRUCTURAL_NOISE`, `semanticallyComplete=true`. Joint-and-several liability silently converted to several liability.
- S4: `The Borrower shall not, directly or indirectly, create any Lien upon the Collateral.` -> anti-evasion language dropped silently.
- S9: `The Borrower shall not make any Investment, except as provided in Section 6.02, at any time prior to the Maturity Date.` -> the entire cross-referenced exception dropped silently.

OCR variants collapse *into* the list: `"sub-ject to the fore-going,"` and `"in-cluding the fol-lowing,"` -> `STRUCTURAL_NOISE` (`:203` strips `[^a-z]` after matching hyphenated tokens), as does zero-width- and ideographic-space-separated text.

## 4. BLOCKER - `COVERED_BY_CHILD_DESCENT` discharges lead-ins carrying full obligations
`source-coverage.ts:333-343`; the only guard is `s.values.length === 0` at `:339`. There is no check that the lead-in is short, verb-free, or proposition-free.

S5 input, model inventories only the two children:
```
The Borrower shall prepay the Loans in full upon a Change of Control and shall cure any Default within thirty days after notice and shall not incur any Indebtedness other than (a) the Existing Debt (b) the Revolving Loans.
```
Observed: the entire 170-char lead-in -> `COVERED_BY_CHILD_DESCENT`; `INVENTORY_OK`, `unaccounted=0`, `uninventoriedValues=0`, `semanticallyComplete=true`, rollup `SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE`. A change-of-control prepayment obligation, a cure period and an incurrence prohibition all disappear because two exception children were inventoried.

Further confirmed cases:
- V6 carve-out lead-in: `This Section shall not apply to any Excluded Subsidiary and shall be tested only on the last day of each of (a) ... (b) ...` -> silent.
- V1 unrecognised-currency cap in the lead-in (`CHF 2,000,000`) -> silent, while the identical text with `$2,000,000` (V2, control) correctly yields `INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP`. The value guard is only as strong as the scanner.
- V3 spelled-out cure period (`one hundred and eighty days`) in the lead-in -> silent.
- Honest note: V5 (nested list, inner enumerated lead-in) **was** surfaced - descent credit does not chain through an enumerated parent.

## 5. BLOCKER - quoted operative text is dismissed as a defined-term label
`source-coverage.ts:215` (`DEFINED_TERM_LABEL_RE`), applied at `:231`. Any quoted run up to 120 chars alone in a segment qualifies, including one containing sentence terminators.

S6 input:
```
Section 6.02 of the Credit Agreement is amended and restated to read as follows: "The Borrower shall not make any Restricted Payment while any Default is continuing."
```
Model inventories only the lead-in. Observed: the replacement text -> `DEFINED_TERM_LABEL`; `semanticallyComplete=true`, rollup `SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE`. This is the ordinary shape of an amendment - the entire new covenant is the thing being dropped.

## 6. BLOCKER - non-Latin-script text is classified as punctuation
`source-coverage.ts:225`: `if (!/[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(trimmed)) return { disposition: "PUNCTUATION_OR_DELIMITER", ... }`.

S7 input: a Chinese negative-pledge sentence between two English clauses -> `PUNCTUATION_OR_DELIMITER`, `unaccounted=0`, `semanticallyComplete=true`. Same for Cyrillic. Any CJK/Cyrillic/Greek/Arabic clause - a bilingual agreement, a foreign-law guarantee, an Arabic-Indic numeral - is dispositioned as "punctuation and delimiters only, no alphanumeric content". This is a whole-language blind spot at the trust boundary.

## 7. BLOCKER - a bare integer is "page furniture"; the scanner's value set is the real gate
`source-coverage.ts:212` (`PAGE_FURNITURE_RE`, middle alternative `[-–—\s]*\d+[-–—\s]*`) applied at `:229`; scanner patterns at `quantitative.ts:48-56`.

S8 input (basket table):
```
The following baskets apply:
General Basket
25000000
Acquisition Basket
40000000
The Borrower shall not exceed the applicable basket.
```
`25000000` -> `NON_SEMANTIC_FORMATTING`; `unaccounted=0`, `uninventoriedValues=0`, `semanticallyComplete=true`.

Scanner blind spots measured (`p3.ts`) - each returns **zero** values, so it never appears in `uninventoriedValues` and never triggers the value guards at `:228`/`:339`:
`five million dollars`, `fifty percent`, `one hundred and eighty days`, `thirty days`, `one-half`, `one half of one percent`, `twenty-five basis points`, `¥500,000,000`, `CHF 2,000,000`, `2,500,000`, `3/31/2030`, `31 March 2030`.
Claim (2) ("every quantitative kind blocks completeness in every region") holds only for values the scanner *recognises*; recognition, not disposition, is the actual gate.

## 8. BLOCKER - one overbroad item span discharges an entire unit
`inventory.ts:219-222` (all scanner values inside a span are auto-attached to it), `source-coverage.ts:279-282` (mask fill), `:312`.

Nothing checks that an item's span is proportionate to its proposition. Scripted model returns **one** item, `materiality: CRITICAL`, `proposition: "this section contains provisions"`, `excerpt` = the whole region:
```
The Borrower shall not incur Indebtedness exceeding $10,000,000. The Borrower shall maintain a Leverage Ratio of not more than 4.00 to 1.00 as of the last day of each fiscal quarter. The cure period is 30 days.
```
Observed (`e2e4.ts`): all three values auto-attached to the one item; `INVENTORY_OK`, `unaccounted=0`, `uninventoriedValues=0`; with an IR carrying a `MONEY 10000000` literal, a `RATIO 4` and a condition description mentioning "30 days", the item reconciles `REPRESENTED`, `semanticallyComplete=true`, `reasons: []`, rollup `SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE`. Three distinct propositions collapse into one vacuous one with no signal. The header comment at `:259-262` ("half of a boundary-free sentence can never disappear behind one broad item span") is true only of *half* a sentence; a whole unit disappears.

## 9. MAJOR - the gap re-inventory call converts detection into model say-so
`inventory.ts:300-322`, status branch `:335`.

Detection is indeed model-independent, but the *verdict* is not. Scripted caller: first call returns `items: []`; the gap call echoes the reported gap excerpt back as one `CRITICAL` item with `proposition: "acknowledged"`. Observed: `gapReinventory={attempted:true, segmentsBefore:1, itemsAdded:1, segmentsAfter:0}`, status flips `INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP` -> `INVENTORY_OK`, `semanticallyComplete=true`, rollup `SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE`. Nothing validates that an added item says anything about the text it closes. Claim (3) is true as stated and false in effect.

## 10. MAJOR - `ExternalAccountabilityLink` discharges a whole region on two unverified strings
`source-coverage.ts:265` (filter is only `ownerCandidateRef && ownerInventoryHash` non-empty) and `:274`.

`computeSourceCoverage({regions:[xref-0 with a full negative covenant], spans:[], externalAccountability:[{regionId:"xref-0", ownerCandidateRef:"does-not-exist", ownerInventoryHash:"not-a-real-hash"}]})` -> the entire region becomes `ACCOUNTED_BY_EXTERNAL_UNIT`, `unaccounted=0`, `unaccountedValues=0`. No owner existence check, no hash verification, no cross-check that the named unit's inventory covers that text. Currently latent in production (no non-test caller constructs links - grep shows only `tests/.../harness.ts:84`), so I rate it MAJOR-latent rather than BLOCKER, but it is an unauthenticated bypass sitting on the trust boundary.

## 11. MAJOR - the "three independent enforcement points" are three reads of one field
`inventory.ts:335`, `reconciliation.ts:447`, `semantic/compile.ts:354`.

All three test `unaccountedSource.length > 0` / `INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP`, i.e. the same output of the same detector. In every scenario above all three passed clean simultaneously. They are redundant against a *dropped status string*, not independent against a *wrong disposition*. Claim (4) is true as written and provides no defence-in-depth for the failure mode that actually occurs.

## 12. MINOR - duplicate `regionId` causes cross-region masking
`source-coverage.ts:279-282` keys the mask on `regionId` alone. Two regions sharing an id: an item span in region A masks the *same offsets* in region B. Demonstrated: one `CRITICAL` span over region A's 82 chars marked all 79 chars of an unrelated region B as `COVERED_BY_INVENTORY`, `unaccounted=0`. Unreachable through `resolveSourceContext` today (ids are `operative` / `xref-N`, `source-context.ts:183,251`), but the function accepts it silently and the input type does not forbid it.

## 13. MINOR - zero regions / empty region id are vacuously complete
`computeSourceCoverage({regions: [], spans: []})` -> `unaccounted=0`, `regionsConsidered=[]`; `inventory.ts:339-340` then returns `INVENTORY_OK` ("source coverage accounts for every stretch of source"), `accountedCharFraction` forced to `1` at `inventory.ts:143`. An empty region id also accepts an external link keyed on `""`. Nothing distinguishes "nothing to account for" from "we were handed nothing".

## 14. MINOR - `options.accountability: false` yields a trusted-looking compile
`semantic/compile.ts:152-153, 176`. With it, `frozenInventory`/`accountability` are `null` and none of the guards at `:344-368` can fire, so status can be `COMPLETED` with empty `failureReasons`. Rollup does catch it (`rollup.ts:22`, `REVIEW_REQUIRED`), and only test files pass it today - so: a disclosed escape hatch whose only backstop is the rollup.

## 15. FALSE_POSITIVE - genuine furniture reported as unaccounted
`classifyUnaccountedFragment` returns `UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE` for: `"[Signature Page Follows]"`, `"Table of Contents"`, `"Name: Jane Doe\nTitle: Chief Financial Officer"`, `"CREDIT AGREEMENT dated as of March 3, 2029 among ACME CORP., ..."` (which also emits a spurious `DATE` value), and the tail of `"IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement..."`. Harmless relative to the above, and correct posture (over-report beats under-report), but it means the caption/furniture rules are simultaneously too permissive for operative text and too narrow for real furniture.

## 16. DISCLOSED-LIMITATION - what I could **not** break
- **Determinism/ordering**: span order, duplicate spans and duplicate item submissions produce byte-identical results (`p2.ts` E: order-invariant `true`, duplicate-invariant `true`).
- **Materiality gate**: an `INFORMATIONAL` span accounts for nothing - full residue surfaces (`accountsForSource`, `:254`).
- **Region-kind neutrality**: coverage genuinely iterates every region; I found no region-label filter. A gap in a `CROSS_REFERENCE_EXPANSION` region surfaces normally.
- **Segmentation**: partial coverage of a punctuation-free run-on correctly leaves the uncovered tail `UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE`; a 5,000-char single token surfaces; values straddling commas are protected (`March 31, 2030` stays in one unit).
- **Recognised values**: every scanner-recognised kind (MONEY/PERCENT/RATIO/DAYS/DATE/PERIOD/MULTIPLIER) does block in every region and cannot be dismissed by any noise/heading/furniture rule (the `values.length === 0` guard at `:228` holds).
- **Nested lists**: descent credit does not chain through an enumerated lead-in (V5 surfaced).

---

### Root cause, in one line
The inversion at `:20-35` is implemented correctly for the *default*; the defect is that six of the nine escape hatches are shape heuristics (length ceiling, capitalisation, quotation marks, digits-only, ASCII-only, a closed word list) that material drafting routinely satisfies - and one (`COVERED_BY_CHILD_DESCENT`) discharges arbitrary substance on a guard the value scanner cannot uphold. "Heuristics never define the trust boundary" is not true of this file: `HEADING_OR_LABEL`, `DEFINED_TERM_LABEL`, `NON_SEMANTIC_FORMATTING`, `PUNCTUATION_OR_DELIMITER` and `STRUCTURAL_NOISE` are all in `ACCOUNTED` (`:63-73`), so each heuristic is load-bearing.
